people.name: Arabia
people.line: A region and its inhabitants, mentioned in various contexts.

people.name: Dedan
people.line: An Arabian people and region, involved in trade.

translations.web: The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, you caravans of Dedanites.
translations.bsb: This is the burden against Arabia: In the thickets of Arabia you must lodge, O caravans of Dedanites.
translations.kjv: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
translations.asv: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye caravans of Dedanites.
